answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh anchor. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its mesa from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. The forge ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal crlys.
